lawyer:
Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed with SM Munir, Advocates ------ For the Appellants.

parties:
Padmabati Biswas ------ Appellants 
Vs. 
Bangladesh and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 22. We have heard Mr. Khondker Mahbub-uddin Ahmed, the learned Advocate appearing for the appellants, and Mr. Moazzem Hossain, the Deputy Attorney-General appearing on behalf of the contesting respondent No. 1. Mr. Khondker contends that the learned Subordinate Judge in his judgment has elaborately discussed the case of the government-plaintiff and defendant Nos. 2-11 on making a presumption that the disputed lands are accretions to the island chars and did not discuss in detail the case of the defendant-appellants that these were reformation in situ of land of Jalma and Ringamari mouzas, that the Collector's map appended to the letter of reference does not depict the true picture of the locality and that the Court did not take any step to ascertain the identity of the land which were subject matter of the previous suit and with respect to which decree was passed by a competent Court. Mr. Khondker further contends that in order to arrive at a correct decision there should be fresh survey of the locality by a competent surveyor and in the map the condition of the river Kazibacha as it was at the time of CS operation and subsequent change of course as well as the situation of the three mouzas in question, namely Tetultala, Jalma and Ringamari should be properly depicted.
